caption:
Figure 2. Overview of the model architecture. Following
DUSt3R [75], images are encoded then decoded with a ViT back-
bone into pointmaps, from which focals, depthmaps and relative
pose can be extracted. Pow3R introduces optional inputs to guide
the regression with prior knowledge about the camera intrinsics
and depth (fed into the encoder) and the pose (into the decoder).
